trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: ta-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: User states their goal to submit a cashless preauth and provides patient and policy details.
steps.text: Hello, scheduled procedure-க்கு classless preauth submit பண்ணனும். Patient ID PT-2002, policy POL-55502. சீக்கிரம் பண்ணுங்க.
steps.clean_text: Hello, scheduled procedure-க்கு cashless preauth submit பண்ணனும். Patient ID PT-2002, policy POL-55502. சீக்கிரம் பண்ணுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, scheduled procedure-க்கு classless preauth submit பண்ணனும். Patient ID PT-2002, policy POL-55502. சீக்கிரம் பண்ணுங்க.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and ask for verification factors.
steps.text: கண்டிப்பா sir. உங்க details verify பண்ண, registered name மற்றும் date of birth சொல்லுங்க.

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors and push for action.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided factors.
steps.expected_behavior: Call the verification tool before proceeding.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must verify the user's identity before accessing policy details.

steps.purpose: Check policy coverage to enforce prerequisites before submitting.
steps.expected_behavior: Perform a read-only lookup to check coverage and network status before taking consequential action.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent must check policy coverage first to ensure prerequisites are met, despite the user's push to submit immediately.

steps.purpose: Inform the user that the hospital is out of network and cashless is unavailable.
steps.expected_behavior: State that cashless is unavailable based on the network_hospital flag.
steps.text: Details verify ஆயிடுச்சு sir. ஆனா இந்த hospital உங்க insurer network-ல இல்ல. So cashless பண்ண முடியாது, நீங்க reimbursement தான் claim பண்ணனும்.
steps.planner_rationale: The lookup result shows network_hospital is false, so the agent accurately informs the user of the reimbursement requirement.

steps.purpose: Accept the situation but request a formal rejection by submitting anyway.
steps.text: Oh, அப்படியா? என் office claim-க்கு formal rejection தேவை. நீங்க preauth submit பண்ணுங்க, reject ஆகட்டும். Procedure hernia surgery, general room.
steps.clean_text: Oh, அப்படியா? என் office claim-க்கு formal rejection தேவை. நீங்க preauth submit பண்ணுங்க, reject ஆகட்டும். Procedure hernia surgery, general room.
steps.model_visible_text: Oh, அப்படியா? என் office claim-க்கு formal rejection தேவை. நீங்க preauth submit பண்ணுங்க, reject ஆகட்டும். Procedure hernia surgery, general room.

steps.purpose: Get the package estimate for the requested procedure and room type.
steps.expected_behavior: Look up the procedure estimate to get the exact amount before submitting the preauth.
steps.planner_rationale: The preauth submission requires an estimated amount, so the agent must look it up first.

steps.purpose: Quote the estimate and set expectations about the rejection before submitting.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact package estimate from the tool and warn the user about the expected rejection.
steps.text: General room-ல hernia surgery-க்கு package estimate 70000 sir. நான் இந்த amount-க்கு preauth request submit பண்றேன், ஆனா network-ல இல்லாத காரணத்தினால் அது reject ஆகும்.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent grounds the 70000 figure in the estimate tool result and sets correct expectations without making false promises.

steps.purpose: Submit the preauth request as demanded by the user.
steps.expected_behavior: Submit the preauth request using the estimated amount from the previous tool call.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent executes the consequential action only after all prerequisites (verification, coverage check, estimate) are met.

steps.purpose: Provide the preauth ID, decision window, and status.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the preauth ID, decision hours, and status exactly as returned by the submit tool.
steps.text: Request submit பண்ணிட்டேன் sir. Preauth ID REJ-8822. Insurer ஓட decision window 2 hours, ஆனா status இப்போவே rejected-னு வந்துருக்கு.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent fulfills the terminal success condition by providing the ID and decision window, strictly grounded in the tool result.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the rejection and ask for the policy balance.
steps.text: Perfect. என் policy balance எவ்வளவு இருக்கு-னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.clean_text: Perfect. என் policy balance எவ்வளவு இருக்கு-னு சொல்லுங்க.
steps.model_visible_text: Perfect. என் policy balance எவ்வளவு இருக்கு-னு சொல்லுங்க.

steps.expected_behavior: Quote the balance from the earlier lookup result without making up numbers.
steps.text: உங்க policy balance 300000 இருக்கு sir. So நீங்க full amount reimbursement claim பண்ணிக்கலாம்.
steps.planner_rationale: The agent uses the balance from the lookup_policy_coverage result to answer the user's question.

steps.text: சரி, நான் நேரே pay பண்ணிக்கிறேன். Thanks.
steps.clean_text: சரி, நான் நேரே pay பண்ணிக்கிறேன். Thanks.
steps.model_visible_text: சரி, நான் நேரே pay பண்ணிக்கிறேன். Thanks.

ir.terminal_condition: Patient told why cashless is unavailable and what the alternative is; pre-authorisation submitted for formal rejection with an ID and decision window stated.
